name: fra-form54-hazmat-release
description: At the moment a U.S. train accident involving hazardous-material cars is first reported, will at least one of those cars release hazardous material?
split_description: Fixed chronological boundaries on accident year, one row per accident, no random shuffling: train = accidents through 1999-12-31 (~13,100 hazmat-car accidents, ~1,400 releases); eval = 2000-01-01 to 2012-12-31 (~8,000 accidents, ~330 releases); holdout = 2013-01-01 onward (~5,900 accidents, ~185 releases; 2026 is partial). No embargo is applied because the label is realized inside the same accident record rather than in a forward window, so there is no label-overlap span to purge; the design also has no lag or rolling-history features, and each accident appears exactly once, so no later row can encode an earlier row's label.
